$comment: The figure tile grid's column contract. A row holds as many tiles as fit at the minimum tile width (--tile-min-width) in the page column, up to max: columns = min(tiles, fit), so six tiles at full width draw five and one. scripts/tile-columns-rendered.mjs reads the grid as painted and judges it against this. The cases are the contract written out for the reference geometry (a 192px minimum and a 16px gap) at three page column widths; the script's self-test proves its own oracle gives the same numbers.
